CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER N0.14 OF 2002
An Order to amend
the Conduct of General Elections Order, 2002
[Gazette of Pakistan;
Extraordinary, Part 1, 14th May, 2002]
F.No.2(4)/2002-Pub., dated
14--2002.--The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is hereby
published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Order may be called the Conduct of General
Elections (Amendment) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Insertion of new Article 7A, Chief Executive's Order No.7 of 2002

CONDUCT OF GENERAL ELECTIONS (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
CONDUCT OF GENERAL ELECTIONS (AMENDMENT)
ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER N0.14 OF 2002
An Order to amend
the Conduct of General Elections Order, 2002
[Gazette of Pakistan;
Extraordinary, Part 1, 14th May, 2002]
F.No.2(4)/2002-Pub., dated
14--2002.--The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is hereby
published for general information:---
2. Insertion of new Article
7A, Chief Executive's Order No.7 of 2002.--In the Conduct of General
Elections Order, 2002 (Chief Executive's Order No.7 of 2002), after Article 7,
the following new Article shall be inserted, namely:--
"7A. Age of
voters.--Notwithstanding anything contained in the Constitution or any other
law for the time being in force including the Electoral Rolls Act, 1974 (XXI of
1974), for the election of members of the National Assembly and Provincial
Assemblies, a citizen who has attained the age of eighteen years on the first
day of January, 2002, shall be eligible to vote and the Chief Election
Commissioner shall cause the electoral rolls to be prepared accordingly under
the provisions of the Electoral Rolls Act, 1974:
Provided that any claim for
inclusion of any name or objection against any entry M tile electoral roll
shall be made to the Revising Authority within 15 days of the publication of
the draft electoral roll. "
